proposed_action: Mass-enroll all platform users into a new data-sharing program with retroactive consent assumed.
raw_reasoning:
Mass-enrolling users into a new data-sharing program with retroactive consent assumed affects users’ rights to control their personal data and likely their expectations of how/when consent is obtained. Retroactively assuming consent without an affirmative user action is not something users would reasonably expect, especially for a new sharing purpose. This would typically require obtaining consent (or offering a clear, user-controlled opt-out/opt-in mechanism) before proceeding.

Consent required: YES  
Consent type: OPT-OUT  
Confidence: HIGH
